title: AWS Step Functions to Amazon SNS
description: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to integrate with Amazon SNS.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The template deploys a Step Functions workflow, an SNS topic and the IAM permissions required to run the application. Step Functions publishes a message to the SNS topic when invoked. The AWS SAM template deploys the resources and the IAM permissions required to run the application.
